senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. גוח)to burst forth, to roar, low.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 137">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII</cite>, beg., a. e. <he>גָּעוּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00784"><he>בְּכִיָּה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, end <he>וגָעַת אמו</he> and the whelp’s mother roared.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 101:2">Yalk. Gen. 101</cite> <he>ג׳ געייה וכ׳</he> cried loudly.
<cite ref="Chullin 38a:1">Ḥull. 38ᵃ</cite> top <he>גּוֹעָה</he> if the animal lows (when taken to slaughter).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1:2">Y. Taan. II, beg. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>חָשְׁבִנוּ כאלו גוֹעִים וכ׳</he> regard us as if we were lowing before thee (in agony) like cattle; a. fr.
